basic_profile.bio: Based in the Midwest, I'm a 34-year-old true crime enthusiast with a background in criminal psychology. I work as a freelance writer, specializing in crime documentaries and podcasts. I'm single and often spend my evenings online discussing plot twists and character arcs with fellow fans. I have a particular fondness for the series 'Criminal Minds' and enjoy analyzing how real-life procedures compare to their fictional counterparts. My online hours typically range from 8 PM to midnight CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in criminal psychology stems from my undergraduate degree in psychology and a minor in criminology. I've been an avid self-learner, frequently attending workshops and seminars on criminal behavior and profiling. This has been further enriched by my freelance writing work, which requires in-depth research into criminal cases.
